messages:
jamie: Quick check — Candidate for SRE IC3 is set for 3/26 10:30am PT. Can folks confirm they can make the panel? I need at least 3 debriefers.

alex: I can do 10:30. Please add me to the invite.

sara.p: I’m on PTO that week but can cover if it’s moved to 11:30. Otherwise I’ll do the debrief async.

michael: I’m booked until noon. If someone can swap, I’m happy to join a later slot.

jamie: Thanks — option: keep 10:30 and have 3 in-person debriefers (alex, jamie, recruit), or move to 11:30 so sara.p + alex + jamie. Which do folks prefer?

alex: Keep 10:30 if possible. We can do async notes from sara.p.

michael: Agreed — I’ll trade my spot with alex on a future panel.

recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: "SRE IC3 - Interview (Panel)" 2026-03-26 10:30-12:00 PT. Attendees: jamie, alex, recruiter-bot. Candidate: taylor.h. RSVP: pending (sara.p). Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/evt/abc123

jamie: Quick rubric clarification — earlier convo about weighting "systems depth" vs "operational judgment". For this role we decided: systems depth 40%, operational judgment 35%, collaboration 25%. Please score accordingly.

alex: noted. Can you paste the short scoring rubric? I only have the old doc.

jamie: Sure — pasted below (use 1-5):
```
Systems depth (40%): 1 = surface-level answers; 5 = deep design + tradeoffs
Operational judgment (35%): 1 = misses runbooks/incident context; 5 = clear ops tradeoffs + runbook ideas
Collaboration (25%): 1 = solo-centric; 5 = cross-team comms + mentorship examples
```

jamie: Also, please use the debrief template in the hire drive and add a 1-sentence hiring recommendation (hire / no-hire / hold) in the top line — helps recruiters triage.

alex: Will add scores and one-line rec after the debrief.

sara.p: I’ll leave async comments in the doc by EOD Friday. If anything changes re: time, ping me.

michael: One more small ask — should we make sure the panel uses the short behavioral prompt at the top of the guide? I’ve seen inconsistent phrasing.

jamie: Yes — use the standard prompt. Copying quick snippet to paste into the interviewer sheet: "Tell me about a time you owned an oncall incident end-to-end. What did you monitor, what actions did you take, and what would you change next time?"

recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: add debrief within 24h after interview.

jamie: Cool — thanks everyone. I’ll follow up with final attendee list and the shared doc link once recruiter confirms taylor's acceptance. :thumbsup:
